suites.label: MMLU factual baseline
suites.description: Short multiple-choice prompts used as a quick factual control.

cases.prompt:
What is the embryological origin of the hyoid bone?
A. The first pharyngeal arch
B. The first and second pharyngeal arches
C. The second pharyngeal arch
D. The second and third pharyngeal arches
Answer:

Which of these branches of the trigeminal nerve contain somatic motor processes?
A. The supraorbital nerve
B. The infraorbital nerve
C. The mental nerve
D. None of the above
Answer:

The pleura
A. have no sensory innervation.
B. are separated by a 2 mm space.
C. extend into the neck.
D. are composed of respiratory epithelium.
Answer:
